goal: Prevent exposing Windows codesigning passphrases in process listings during detached signing
Protects release signers from credential exposure to local users or monitoring tools
agreement: Neutral concept stance without explicit backing (hebasto)
Unanswered question on whether printf is guaranteed to be a shell builtin across all shells (hebasto)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it hardens release signing tooling by keeping private passphrases out of process tables
Release signing is typically run in isolated environments, making this modest credential hardening
